project.name: Snowboard Prep PWA - QA Round 2 Improvements
project.description: Remove sound effects, remove voice commands, improve voice assistance with better counting logic, remove illustrations, and consolidate pace UI

tasks.title: Remove sound effects and keep only voice assistance
tasks.description: Remove all sound effect functionality from the app, keeping only voice assistance for auditory feedback
criteria: Remove SoundContext and SoundProvider from the app
Remove all sound effect imports and usage from components
Remove /src/assets/sounds/ directory and audio files
Remove /scripts/generate-sounds.cjs script
Remove sound-related code from ActivityTimer.tsx (timer completion, side transitions)
Remove sound-related code from ActivityScreen.tsx
Remove playSideTransition() and other sound function calls
Keep voice assistance functionality intact
No references to sound effects remain in codebase
App works without any audio files

tasks.title: Remove voice commands functionality
tasks.description: Remove voice command recognition from RepCounter and settings since it doesn't work on iOS
criteria: Remove SpeechRecognition code from VoiceContext.tsx
Remove recognitionAvailable state and detection
Remove startListening() and stopListening() functions
Remove isListening state
Remove voice command handling from RepCounter.tsx
Remove voice commands toggle from Settings UI
Remove voiceCommandsEnabled from SettingsContext
Remove listening indicator UI and CSS
Remove .voice-listening-indicator CSS
Keep only SpeechSynthesis functionality for voice counting
Update VoiceContext to be synthesis-only
No recognition-related code remains

tasks.title: Enhance voice assistance for rep counting activities
tasks.description: Improve voice counting logic: say 'start' at beginning, count from 'one', say 'last one' for penultimate rep, say 'switch sides' between sides, add 'and' for slower paces
criteria: Say 'start' when voice counting begins (before first rep)
Count starts at 'one' (not zero) to indicate rep completion
Say 'last one' instead of the penultimate number (e.g., if 10 reps, say 'last one' instead of '9')
Say 'switch sides' when transitioning between sides in multi-sided activities
For paces slower than 2 seconds, say 'and' at the half-second mark between counts
Say 'next activity' during countdown buffer before next activity
Voice logic integrated into RepCounter.tsx voice counting
Handle edge cases (1 rep activities, 2 rep activities)
Works correctly with auto-start voice counting

tasks.title: Enhance voice assistance for timed activities
tasks.description: Add voice assistance to timed activities: say 'start' when timer starts, 'switch sides' between sides, 'done' when complete, 'five seconds left' for timers >10s
criteria: Say 'start' when the timer starts on first side
Say 'switch sides' when transitioning between sides
Pause for countdown buffer between sides, then say 'start' again on second side
Say 'done' when timer ends completely
For timers greater than 10 seconds, say 'five seconds left' at the 5-second mark
Voice logic integrated into ActivityTimer.tsx
Works with multi-sided timed activities
Respects voiceCountingEnabled setting
Uses VoiceContext speak() function

tasks.title: Remove activity illustrations to save vertical space
tasks.description: Remove illustration images from activity screens, keeping only text descriptions
criteria: Remove illustration display from ActivityScreen.tsx
Remove illustration-related CSS
Activity text descriptions remain visible and clear
More vertical space available for other UI elements
Layout adjusts properly without illustrations
No broken image references
Illustration data can remain in activity definitions (just not displayed)

tasks.title: Consolidate voice assistance pace UI with increment/decrement buttons
tasks.description: Combine pace UI elements into single component showing 'set pace' or current pace with +/- buttons to adjust by 0.2s increments
criteria: Single pace UI element replaces multiple elements on workout screen
Shows 'set pace' button if no pace is set (pace === 0 or null)
Shows current pace value (e.g., '2.0s') if pace is set
Clicking pace value opens tap-to-set interface (existing behavior)
Add '-' button on left side to decrement pace by 0.2 seconds
Add '+' button on right side to increment pace by 0.2 seconds
Pace value constrained to reasonable range (e.g., 1.0s - 5.0s)
Buttons disabled at min/max bounds
Visual layout: [- button] [pace value/set pace button] [+ button]
Pace persists to activity settings per-activity
Works in RepCounter component
Responsive design works on mobile
Clear visual hierarchy and touch targets
